name: Hologram HUD: cyan lines on black, amber for locked values
for: scanning, sensing, tracking, surveillance and security topics; a target locks and digits resolve

motion.ease: a target locks in 0.2 s with a 3-frame flash; digits scramble, then lock
motion.note: amber only for locked values; put a dark plate under any text on wireframe

camera: an orbit, no cuts; additive 1.3 px lines and depth fog

sound.mood: saw arpeggio, one silent beat before a lock

source: colour roles and type notes after lemo-opuscar's hologram-hud notes (MIT); surface, muted and the display size are ours
